sentences.en: What you're saying would help explain the president's comments on Wednesday in that bipartisan
sentences.zh: 你所说的有助于解释总统周三在那场你提到的两党会议上的言论，

sentences.en: meeting you mentioned, where he said pretty explicitly that he's basically not scared of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 他在会上非常明确地表示，他基本上不怕NRA。

sentences.en: He said, you know, they have influence with you, lawmakers, not as much with me, which was pretty extraordinary coming from a Republican president.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，他们在你们这些议员那里有影响力，在我这儿没那么大，这对于一个共和党总统来说相当非同寻常。

sentences.en: Look, all of this is about, for a lot of people, it's about getting reelected.
sentences.zh: 听着，对许多人来说，这一切都是为了赢得连任。

sentences.en: And the bottom line is the NRA has a sophisticated ability to either help you continue to call yourself congressman.
sentences.zh: 最底线的是，NRA拥有强大的能力来帮助你继续自称为国会议员。

sentences.en: The only way that that will change is if somebody who is seen even in a, like Donald Trump is
sentences.zh: 这种情况要发生改变，唯一的途径就是出现一个在各方面——就像唐纳德·特朗普那样——比NRA获得更好公众形象的人，

sentences.en: seen in a better light than the NRA, comes along and basically tells the NRA, we're changing
sentences.zh: 站出来直接告诉NRA，我们要改变你们这些年来一直奉行的这一部分

sentences.en: this part of the portfolio or whatever you want to call it, that you guys have been espousing over the years.
sentences.zh: 政策组合或随便你们怎么称呼的东西。

sentences.en: And if you don't accept this, then we're going to have a fight on it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不接受这一点，那我们就为此大干一场。

sentences.en: And you got to decide whether or not you want to have that fight with me.
sentences.zh: 你得决定你究竟想不想跟我干这一仗。

sentences.en: The president wins that fight.
sentences.zh: 总统会赢得那场较量。

sentences.en: It's just a matter of how far he's willing to go.
sentences.zh: 这只是他愿意走多远的问题。

sentences.en: So let's talk about you and guns for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 那我们花一会儿时间来聊聊你和枪支的问题。

sentences.en: You have an NRA rating of A, but it sounds like you're cheering for what the president is saying in these meetings.
sentences.zh: 你的NRA评级是A，但听起来你在为总统在这些会议上的言论欢呼。

sentences.en: So what kind of gun control are you hoping for?
sentences.zh: 那你希望看到什么样的枪支管控？

sentences.en: Well, I saw the pictures of this kid from Parkland, you know, that that guy can go buy an AR-15, but he can't buy a handgun in Florida.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我看到了帕克兰那个孩子的照片，你知道的，那家伙在佛罗里达州可以买到AR-15，却买不到手枪。

sentences.en: And I think our governor's trying to change that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们的州长正试图改变这一点。

sentences.en: That's number one.
sentences.zh: 这是第一点。

sentences.en: So this kid can buy an AR-15, but, you know, I've gone shooting with my son, whale hunting or whatever, hog hunting out in Okeechobee.
sentences.zh: 所以这孩子可以买AR-15，但是，你知道的，我和我儿子一起去打过猎，捕鲸或者别的什么，在奥基乔比打野猪。

sentences.en: And so I've had to show him how to use a shotgun and a rifle.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不教他如何使用猎枪和步枪。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's under my supervision.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，那是在我的监督下。

sentences.en: So I think that it's different.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这不一样。

sentences.en: I also own, you know, handguns that are in safes next to my bed because I feel more comfortable
sentences.zh: 我也拥有放在床头保险箱里的手枪，因为我觉得

sentences.en: going to sleep that if somebody comes in my house with a weapon that I'll at least have a chance to defend myself.
sentences.zh: 如果有人持武器闯入我的家，至少我能有机会保护自己，这样睡觉会更踏实。

sentences.en: So, you know, that's why I own guns.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就是为什么我拥有枪支。

sentences.en: But, you know, also, I don't know how I feel about this AR I went shooting with at the
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，同时，我不知道我对这把AR作何感想，我当时去靶场

sentences.en: range and somebody had an AR-15 and literally, you know, we're shooting our, talk to this guy about like, you know, our targets and our shootings.
sentences.zh: 有人拿着一把AR-15，说实话，你知道，我们在打靶，和这个人聊起，你知道，我们的靶子和射击情况。

sentences.en: I'm just like, what the hell is that?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，那到底是什么鬼东西？

sentences.en: And he's like, that's an AR-15.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，那是AR-15。

sentences.en: And I'm just like, good Lord, it's like a cannon.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，天哪，这简直就像一门大炮。

sentences.en: And so I think that you wouldn't be human if you didn't pause for a second and said, what is the purpose of that gun?
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，如果你不停下来想一秒钟，问一句那把枪的用途是什么，那你就不算是一个正常人。

sentences.en: Especially one with the bump stock.
sentences.zh: 尤其是那种带有速射托的。

sentences.en: After Las Vegas, you know, I really thought that the bump stock thing would be a no-brainer.
sentences.zh: 在拉斯维加斯枪击案之后，你知道，我真的以为禁掉速射托是毫无悬念的事。

sentences.en: And then it just disappeared.
sentences.zh: 然后它就这样消失了。

sentences.en: Nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 什么也没发生。

sentences.en: We should take all these shootings and figure out what are the things that we can do to address these things to try to, you know, stop it from happening in the future again
sentences.zh: 我们应该审视所有这些枪击事件，找出我们能做的事情来解决这些问题，试图，你知道，阻止它在未来再次发生

sentences.en: and act on this.
sentences.zh: 并对此采取行动。

sentences.en: But we don't do anything about giving an inch, whatever the NRA's concern is, is that if you give an inch, that we'll want a mile.
sentences.zh: 但我们什么也没做，生怕退让一步——无论美国步枪协会（NRA）的担忧是什么，就是如果你退让一步，我们就会要求进一丈。

sentences.en: But I don't think that rational people believe that.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为理性的人会这么认为。

sentences.en: If you call for the banning of bump stocks, if you call after going to the range with that
sentences.zh: 如果你呼吁禁止速射托，如果你在和那个联邦调查局探员去过靶场后

sentences.en: FBI agent for a ban on the AR-15, what happens to you, Congressman?
sentences.zh: 呼吁禁止AR-15，议员先生，你会遭遇什么？

sentences.en: What does the NRA do to you?
sentences.zh: 美国步枪协会会怎么对你？

sentences.en: Well, nothing happens to me now because I'm leaving.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在我不会遭遇什么，因为我要离职了。

sentences.en: But it would be a huge problem, politically, a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 但这会是个巨大的政治问题，一个巨大的政治问题。

sentences.en: Every gun store back home would know about it, that Tom Rooney was trying to limit your
sentences.zh: 家乡的每一家枪店都会知道，汤姆·鲁尼（Tom Rooney）试图限制你们的

sentences.en: Second Amendment rights.
sentences.zh: 第二修正案权利。

sentences.en: And hurt your business?
sentences.zh: 还会损害你的生意？

sentences.en: There would probably be mailers.
sentences.zh: 可能会有宣传邮件。

sentences.en: There would probably be a huge political price to pay.
sentences.zh: 可能会付出巨大的政治代价。

sentences.en: So did the shooting in Parkland actually change some of your positions on guns?
sentences.zh: 那么帕克兰的枪击案真的改变了你对枪支的一些立场吗？

sentences.en: I'm wondering why you have such a pure rating from the NRA, given how you're now talking, which is not to say that you don't have some pretty conservative views.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道，鉴你现在的言论，为什么你在美国步枪协会那里还能保持完美的评级，当然这并不是说你没有一些相当保守的观点。

sentences.en: Well, to be honest with you, we don't have bills that come to the floor saying, let's keep the AR-15 legal or let's do a universal background check.
sentences.zh: 嗯，老实说，我们并没有那种提交到议会大厅的法案，说让我们保持AR-15合法或者让我们进行普遍背景调查。

sentences.en: Those things don't come to the floor.
sentences.zh: 那些东西根本不会提交到议会大厅。

sentences.en: They don't ever get to the floor because not enough people.
sentences.zh: 它们永远不会被提交，因为人数不够。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, you're not put in a position where you're having to really look at the things
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，你没有被置于那种必须真正审视那些

sentences.en: that come to the floor, things like, you know, should the Florida concealed weapons permit be honored in New Jersey?
sentences.zh: 提交到议会大厅的事情的境地，比如，你知道，佛罗里达州的隐蔽持枪证是否应该在新泽西州得到承认？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: Seems logical.
sentences.zh: 这似乎合乎逻辑。

sentences.en: I have a concealed weapons permit.
sentences.zh: 我有一张隐蔽持枪证。

sentences.en: I'm a law-abiding citizen.
sentences.zh: 我是一个遵纪守法的公民。

sentences.en: I don't want to get arrested.
sentences.zh: 我不想被捕。

sentences.en: So yeah, I'll vote yes on that.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我会投赞成票。

sentences.en: I think that if it did anything, it made me, because those kids are the same age as my kids.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果它起到了什么作用的话，那就是它让我感同身受，因为那些孩子和我自己的孩子年龄相仿。

sentences.en: So I think that it probably made me of those parents that, you know, were getting texts
sentences.zh: 所以我想它可能让我联想到了那些父母，你知道，他们收到了这样的短信

sentences.en: about, you are a good parent.
sentences.zh: 关于，你是个好家长。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to die now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在要死了。

sentences.en: I mean, that probably had more of an effect on me than anything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能比什么都更能触动我。

sentences.en: And the fact that, you know, that they were just basic.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们只是些普普通通的孩子。

sentences.en: And when you hear teenagers going to Tallahassee or coming to Washington, they can really articulate their points of view with their own voice.
sentences.zh: 当你听到青少年去塔拉哈西或者来到华盛顿，他们能用自己的声音清晰地表达自己的观点时。

sentences.en: You're just like, wow, that's really not something that I ever want to have to hear or get a text from my son, you know.
sentences.zh: 你就会觉得，哇，这真的不是我这辈子想听到或者想从我儿子那里收到的一条短信，你知道的。

sentences.en: Congressman, sounds like you're thinking about being a parent in a moment like that.
sentences.zh: 议员先生，听起来在那种时刻你是在以一个父亲的角度思考。

sentences.en: I don't want to depress you too much on this, but if this shooting didn't necessarily change
sentences.zh: 我不想让你在这个问题上太沮丧，但如果这次枪击案不一定会改变

sentences.en: your positions on guns, why didn't you speak out before now on this?
sentences.zh: 你对枪支的立场，你为什么之前不对此公开表态呢？

sentences.en: Do you put yourself in the group of Republicans who needed the president to go first on this, given the power of the NRA?
sentences.zh: 鉴于美国步枪协会的势力，你是否把自己归入那种需要总统先表态的共和党人行列？

sentences.en: I think that you do.
sentences.zh: 我想你是的。

sentences.en: The reality is, in districts like mine, if you don't have, you know, the kind of support from groups like the NRA, it makes life very difficult.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，在像我这样的选区里，如果没有来自像美国步枪协会这样的团体的支持，日子会非常艰难。

sentences.en: And you said that, you know, that this shooting might not have changed my view on guns.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说，你知道，这次枪击案可能没有改变我对枪支的看法。

sentences.en: I just want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我只想把话说清楚。

sentences.en: I don't know that if it did or didn't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它到底改变了没有。

sentences.en: I think that, look, I'm human.
sentences.zh: 我认为，听着，我是个人。

sentences.en: I don't know how I feel about it sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时我也不知道自己作何感想。

sentences.en: Like I was trying to say to you when somebody was shooting the AR-15 next to me, my first reaction is, why would you need that gun?
sentences.zh: 就像我刚才试图对你说的，当有人在我旁边开枪射击AR-15时，我的第一反应是，你为什么需要那把枪？

sentences.en: You know, but then you hear people that have that gun and you're just like, well, they enjoy shooting it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但随后你听到拥有那支枪的人的声音，你就会觉得，嗯，他们喜欢射击它。

sentences.en: So, and they're law-abiding citizens and they're good people.
sentences.zh: 所以，而且他们是遵纪守法的公民，是好人。

sentences.en: And so why shouldn't they be able to go to the gun range and enjoy themselves with it?
sentences.zh: 那他们为什么不能去靶场享受射击的乐趣呢？

sentences.en: So then you're sort of conflicted and you're just like, well, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以你就会陷入某种纠结，然后你会觉得，嗯，这倒也说得通。

sentences.en: It's just talking about, should law-abiding citizens be punished for the sins of people that aren't or that are bad people?
sentences.zh: 这其实就是在探讨，遵纪守法的公民是否应该为那些不是好人或坏人的罪行受到惩罚？

sentences.en: So how do we eliminate the bad people from getting, how do you pick and choose that?
sentences.zh: 那么我们如何阻止坏人获取枪支，你又该如何去挑选和甄别呢？

sentences.en: But we're not even doing that.
sentences.zh: 但我们甚至连这一点都没在做。

sentences.en: So we haven't been able to do anything.
sentences.zh: 所以我们什么也没能做到。

sentences.en: So, you know, I think that the president has the ability that he does.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为总统确实拥有这种能力。

sentences.en: And I mean, I think that you'd see a lot of people step out and follow him if he does.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为如果他采取行动，你会看到很多人站出来追随他。

sentences.en: So I want to return to where we ended our last conversation back in July when you started
sentences.zh: 所以我想回到我们七月份上次对话结束时的那个话题，当时你

sentences.en: to say that for the time being, you were planning to seek re-election because you still felt
sentences.zh: 开始说，目前你正计划竞选连任，因为你仍然觉得

sentences.en: like you wanted to get things done and you felt like it was a test of whether the Republican
sentences.zh: 自己还有事情想做，而且你觉得这是一个测试，看看共和党

sentences.en: Party could govern in this moment.
sentences.zh: 在此时此刻是否具备执政能力。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of our listeners will be listening and thinking that this is exactly who we want to be in Congress, someone like you.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们的许多听众听完会觉得，这不正是我们想要在国会看到的人吗，像你这样的人。

sentences.en: That's exactly what my chief said when I told her that I wasn't running again.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉我的办公室主任我不再参选时，她也是这么说的。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Because I said, you know, the cost benefit of getting to call myself congressman versus doing something else that I think that I could be useful at or happy doing, it's just going
sentences.zh: 因为我说，你知道，被称为国会议员的成本效益，与做其他我认为自己能发挥作用或做起来开心的事相比，到处跑

sentences.en: around and having people call me congressman just doesn't just doesn't do it for me as much as figuring out something else I want to do.
sentences.zh: 让人叫我国会议员，这对我来说已经不如找出我想做的其他事情那么有吸引力了。

sentences.en: And she goes, well, that's exactly why you should stay.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，好吧，这正是你应该留下的原因。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, so.
sentences.zh: 而我说，好吧，那么。

sentences.en: Rick, but do you feel any sense of guilt that if everyone like you leaves, it's just going to get worse in Congress?
sentences.zh: 里克，但如果像你这样的人都离开，国会的情况只会变得更糟，你内心不会感到一丝内疚吗？

sentences.en: Thought about that.
sentences.zh: 考虑过。

sentences.en: But I mean, you know, I have a lot of friends that are like me, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，你知道，我有很多像我这样的朋友，我想。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're not leaving, so hopefully they'll be able to be part of something great.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们并没有离开，所以希望他们能够成为成就伟大事业的一部分。

sentences.en: But we shall see.
sentences.zh: 但我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: I mean, that's why we have elections.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是我们举行选举的原因。

sentences.en: Congressman, you spoke of your father when we first spoke as the kind of adult in the room that you think that Washington needs right now to fix what's quite evidently broken.
sentences.zh: 议员先生，我们在最初交谈时你谈到了你的父亲，说他是那种华盛顿目前正急需的、能解决显而易见混乱局面的中流砥柱。

sentences.en: Is your father still around?
sentences.zh: 你的父亲还在吗？

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 他在。

sentences.en: What did your father say when you told him that you decided not to run for re-election?
sentences.zh: 当你告诉父亲你决定不再竞选连任时，他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: I think that he wanted me to stay because he always told me that he's like, hey, I know you don't think it's a big deal, but being a congressman is a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 我想他是希望我留下的，因为他总是对我说，嘿，我知道你觉得这不算什么，但当国会议员真的是一件非常了不起的大事。

sentences.en: And, you know, I know that you hear a lot of negative stuff, but it's important.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我知道你听到了很多负面的声音，但这很重要。

sentences.en: And I said, I realize that and I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我说，我意识到了，我也很感激。

sentences.en: But it's just, you know, it's not what I want to do anymore.
sentences.zh: 但这只是，你知道，这已经不是我想做的事了。

sentences.en: And then but he was very supportive.
sentences.zh: 不过他随后还是非常支持我。

sentences.en: Well, Congressman, I want to thank you so much for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 好的，议员先生，我非常感谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: I hope that we can stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能保持联系。

sentences.en: And I hope that whatever you find to be your next calling kind of fulfills your dreams for it.
sentences.zh: 我也希望无论你找到的下一个使命是什么，都能实现你对它的梦想。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I really appreciate you guys as well.
sentences.zh: 我也非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: I think that you've always been very fair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们一直以来都非常公正。

sentences.en: And hopefully, hopefully what you said actually comes true as well.
sentences.zh: 希望，希望你刚才说的话也能真正变成现实。

sentences.en: But anyway, all the best to you.
sentences.zh: 不过无论如何，祝你们一切都好。

sentences.en: And to you as well and your family.
sentences.zh: 也祝你和你的家人一切都好。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: You will have protection for the first time in a long while.
sentences.zh: 你们将迎来久违的保护。

sentences.en: And you've got to regrow your industries.
sentences.zh: 你们必须重振你们的工业。

sentences.en: That's all I'm asking.
sentences.zh: 这就是我全部的要求。

sentences.en: And you have to regrow your industries.
sentences.zh: 你们必须重振你们的工业。

sentences.zh: 周四，在白宫与制造业高管会面期间，

sentences.en: President Trump announced plans to impose steep new tariffs on imported steel and aluminum.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统宣布了对进口钢铁和铝征收巨额新关税的计划。

sentences.en: It'll be 25 percent for steel.
sentences.zh: 钢铁税率为25%。

sentences.en: It'll be 10 percent for aluminum.
sentences.zh: 铝税率为10%。

sentences.en: The tariffs stem from an investigation by the Commerce Department, which found that cheap imported metals have weakened U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些关税源于商务部的一项调查，该调查发现廉价的进口金属削弱了美国的

sentences.en: manufacturers and could threaten national security in a time of crisis.
sentences.zh: 制造商，并可能在危机时期威胁到国家安全。

sentences.en: Because without steel and aluminum, your country's not the same.
sentences.zh: 因为没有钢铁和铝，你们国家的性质就变了。

sentences.en: And we need it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要它们。

sentences.en: We need it even for defense.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至为了国防也需要它们。

sentences.en: If you think, I mean, we need it for defense.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想，我的意思是，我们需要它们来搞国防。

sentences.en: We need great steel makers, great aluminum makers for defense.
sentences.zh: 为了国防，我们需要伟大的钢铁制造商，伟大的铝制造商。

sentences.en: In approving the tariffs, the president overruled both his chief economic advisor and his secretary of defense, who warned that they could hurt U.S.
sentences.zh: 在批准这些关税时，总统否决了他的首席经济顾问和国防部长的意见，他们曾警告称这些关税可能会损害依赖进口钢铁的美国

sentences.en: companies that rely on imported steel and prompt retaliation by companies that export it to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 公司，并引发向美国出口钢铁的公司采取报复行动。

sentences.en: A possible full-fledged trade war.
sentences.zh: 这可能演变成一场全面的贸易战。

sentences.en: The Dow plunging more than 400 points.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯指数暴跌逾400点。

sentences.en: Within minutes of the president's announcement, the stock market tumbled over those exact fears.
sentences.zh: 在总统宣布消息几分钟后，股市就因为这些担忧而暴跌。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎进了一批自诩为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至扣人心弦的权力斗争中。
